nodes.label: Engine.ServeHTTP
nodes.desc: Implements http.Handler: grabs a pooled Context, resets it, dispatches, returns it to the pool

nodes.label: Engine.pool / allocateContext
nodes.desc: sync.Pool of reusable *Context values sized by maxParams and maxSections

nodes.label: handleHTTPRequest
nodes.desc: Selects the per-method tree, runs getValue, falls back to 404/405/redirect paths

nodes.label: methodTrees (one per HTTP method)
nodes.desc: Engine.trees holds one radix tree root per HTTP method

nodes.label: node.getValue
nodes.desc: Zero-allocation iterative walk matching path bytes against node indices

nodes.label: RouterGroup.combineHandlers
nodes.desc: Merges group middleware with route handlers into one HandlersChain at registration

nodes.label: Context.Next
nodes.desc: Advances c.index and invokes pending handlers in the chain

nodes.label: Context.Abort
nodes.desc: Pins index at abortIndex so pending handlers never run

nodes.label: Context.ShouldBind
nodes.desc: Picks a binding engine from method + Content-Type and decodes into a struct

nodes.label: binding.Default
nodes.desc: GET maps to Form binding; body types map by MIME header

nodes.label: defaultValidator (go-playground/validator)
nodes.desc: Runs struct validation with tag name 'binding' after decode

nodes.label: Recovery middleware
nodes.desc: defer recover() around c.Next() converts panics into a 500

edges.label: pick the tree whose method matches
